request_payload.title: Molecular Basis for Synaptotagmin-1-Associated Neurodevelopmental Disorder.

mentions.mention: synchronizes neurotransmitter release with Ca2+ influx during action potential firing
mentions.sentence: At neuronal synapses, synaptotagmin-1 (syt1) acts as a Ca2+ sensor that synchronizes neurotransmitter release with Ca2+ influx during action potential firing.
